expressions.neutral: At rest; shown when nothing else is asked for
expressions.listening: Hearing someone; swells with their voice
expressions.speaking: Talking; the mouth follows the voice
expressions.confused: Uneven eyes and a question mark
expressions.scared: Small trembling eyes, a drop of sweat

charging.description: A battery filling up, with the level from the status

clock.description: The present time on a dial and in digits, with the date

setup.description: Set-up from the app: the code to scan or type, then how set-up is going (protocol/setup/README.md)

state.description: code: the code and its QR code; connected: an app is setting the robot up; connecting: set up, the robot waits for its server; closed: not set up, a tap opens set-up

code.description: The set-up code, 8 digits, shown in two groups of four

discriminator.description: 4 hexadecimal digits that tell robots in set-up apart

timer.description: A ring that empties as the time runs out; pulses at zero

ends_at.description: Unix time, in seconds on the software's clock, when it rings

weather.description: An animated sky, the temperature and the place

night.description: true to show the moon instead of the sun
